projects.title: SignalBridge
projects.tagline: An evidence-led bridge from software sprawl to workflow outcomes, bounded Proof Runs, and governed Parallax execution-contract candidates.
projects.story: SignalBridge begins with manual or CSV software inventory—applications, spend, seats, owners, and usage notes—then clusters tools around the outcomes people actually need. It creates an Outcome Migration Map, evaluates Computational Collaborator readiness and custody, recommends a bounded next proof state, and carries the full decision context into Parallax through a Handoff Manifest.
projects.summary: A wedge product and handoff architecture for workflow clustering, readiness review, receipt requirements, risk and custody notes, economic-delta hypotheses, mock Proof Runs, and explicit human-authorized migration decisions. The original source term agent-readiness is retained in lineage and presented publicly as Computational Collaborator readiness.
projects.see: The SignalBridge cover, Outcome Migration Map, Parallax Handoff Manifest, architecture and Proof Run boundary briefs, fixed-data Outcome Migration Workbench, PAT Bridge Mode, canonical source lineage, and planned audited proof artifacts.
projects.proof: Seven public artifacts are connected. The Workbench deterministically evaluates six synthetic workflow clusters and produces unsigned demonstration handoff manifests while making no uploads, network calls, model calls, account connections, purchases, cancellations, data movements, contract changes, Archive mutations, or production actions.
projects.next: Freeze the portable Handoff Manifest schema and readiness-rubric fixtures, then conduct Proof Run 001 as a mock/no-live-action shadow trial using a frozen synthetic or owner-approved dataset. Publish assumptions, accepted and rejected candidates, authority gates, economic hypotheses, observed results, exceptions, and rollback receipts.
projects.claimBoundary: This package demonstrates SignalBridge architecture, public explanation, fixed synthetic readiness logic, mock Proof Run routing, and a demonstration-only Parallax Handoff Manifest. It does not establish production traction, revenue, verified savings, legal, finance, procurement, security, privacy, or employment advice, automated underwriting, implementation reliability, live integrations, ownership of source data, organizational consent, or authority to alter software, accounts, data, contracts, personnel, vendors, customers, funds, or production workflows. A Proof Run candidate is eligible for human review only and may correctly resolve to not yet.

relationships.note: ALO preserves inputs, assumptions, decisions, actions, evidence, exceptions, rollback, and settlement.
SOSA separates observation, mapping, dissent, authorization, operation, and repair around a handoff candidate.
Census tracks source location, custody, versions, public permission, and canonical artifact relationships.
RoomLight may supply bounded environmental or operational evidence only through declared custody and field-safety rules.
Coherence Bridge reinforces that operational efficiency must not replace human consent, relationship, dignity, or sovereignty.
The Institute defines pilot purpose, partnership boundaries, evidence expectations, and benefit claims.
Archive Core publishes the bounded architecture and receipts without implying live deployment.
